description: Legacy AttestationBundle authenticated-era admission, role binding, and fail-closed reputation effects.

vectors.name: lab-modern-fab-checkpoint-unavailable
vectors.note: LAB applies only to legacy AttestationBundle; a valid FAB does not need era proof

vectors.name: lab-modern-ebfab-no-era-proof
vectors.note: EBFAB admission follows its normal type/SEB gates, not legacy-era proof

vectors.name: lab-authentic-historical-buyer
vectors.note: exact-hash buyer-role anchor finalized strictly before the governed checkpoint

vectors.name: lab-authentic-historical-seller
vectors.note: each role qualifies independently; exact seller-role history is eligible

vectors.name: lab-historical-replay-after-checkpoint
vectors.note: later presentation does not erase the original qualifying pre-checkpoint anchor

vectors.name: lab-same-role-reanchor-keeps-original-proof
vectors.note: a same-role re-anchor after activation remains eligible only through its original receipt

vectors.name: lab-cross-role-rebind-rejected
vectors.note: buyer-role history cannot qualify the same bytes resolved under seller role

vectors.name: lab-fresh-legacy-post-checkpoint
vectors.note: a first legacy anchor after activation is audit-only and non-countable

vectors.name: lab-same-order-not-strictly-before
vectors.note: checkpoint equality does not satisfy the strict-before relation

vectors.name: lab-backdated-fresh-legacy
vectors.note: producer finalisedAt cannot backdate a post-checkpoint anchor

vectors.name: lab-content-hash-mismatch
vectors.note: historical proof for different bytes does not qualify the returned bundle

vectors.name: lab-anchor-substrate-mismatch
vectors.note: history on another substrate cannot satisfy this checkpoint/anchor relation

vectors.name: lab-checkpoint-signature-invalid
vectors.note: an invalid steward signature is deterministic invalidity, not activation authority

vectors.name: lab-checkpoint-signer-unauthorized
vectors.note: a valid signature by a non-steward signer cannot activate the legacy boundary

vectors.name: lab-checkpoint-address-mismatch
vectors.note: a checkpoint not bound to the derived substrate address is invalid

vectors.name: lab-checkpoint-unavailable
vectors.note: unavailable governed checkpoint proof cannot admit or fault a legacy copy

vectors.name: lab-checkpoint-conflicting
vectors.note: multiple conflicting authorized checkpoint candidates fail closed

vectors.name: lab-checkpoint-reorged
vectors.note: an unresolved checkpoint reorganization has no stable activation position

vectors.name: lab-checkpoint-order-unavailable
vectors.note: a finalized checkpoint without authenticated total order cannot activate LAB

vectors.name: lab-anchor-history-missing
vectors.note: missing earliest/exact historical receipt cannot establish creation era

vectors.name: lab-anchor-history-pruned
vectors.note: pruned role-anchor history is not converted into ineligibility or fault

vectors.name: lab-anchor-history-reorged
vectors.note: reorged historical anchor evidence fails closed pending stable proof

vectors.name: lab-anchor-order-unavailable
vectors.note: same-block evidence without authenticated strict ordering cannot qualify
